entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive in DRC.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de tu llegada a la RDC.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in DRC.

entry.en: To enter DRC you must have certificates proving a yellow fever vaccination and, in some circumstances, a polio vaccine.
entry.es: Para entrar a la RDC necesitas certificados de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla y, en algunos casos, contra la polio.
entry.quote: To enter DRC, you must have certificates to prove you’ve had:

entry.en: Travellers may face health screening on arrival and departure, such as a passenger locator form and temperature checks, including at airports.
entry.es: Puede haber controles sanitarios a la llegada y la salida, como un formulario de localización y control de temperatura, también en aeropuertos.
entry.quote: You may encounter health screening measures, such as being required to fill in a passenger locator form on arrival and departure and temperature checks, including at airports.

entry.en: A departure tax of 55 US dollars applies on international flights and 10 US dollars on domestic flights, paid at check-in.
entry.es: Se paga una tasa de salida de 55 dólares en vuelos internacionales y 10 en nacionales, al hacer el check-in.
entry.quote: You need to pay a departure tax of 55 US dollars on international flights and 10 US dollars on domestic flights.

entry.en: You may have difficulties entering DRC if travelling with satellite phones, GPS receivers or military clothing.
entry.es: Puedes tener dificultades al entrar a la RDC si llevas teléfonos satelitales, receptores GPS o ropa militar.
entry.quote: You may have difficulties when entering DRC if you are travelling with:

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to the provinces of Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Maniema, Tanganyika and Haut-Lomami.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a las provincias de Alto Uele, Ituri, Kivu Norte, Kivu Sur, Maniema, Tanganyika y Alto Lomami.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the provinces of:

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in DRC.
safety.es: Es muy probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en la RDC.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in DRC.

safety.en: Foreign nationals are at particular risk of street robbery in Kinshasa, Lubumbashi and other urban centres, especially near hotels and supermarkets in the centre of town.
safety.es: Los extranjeros corren un riesgo especial de robo callejero en Kinsasa, Lubumbashi y otras ciudades, sobre todo cerca de hoteles y supermercados del centro.
safety.quote: Foreign nationals are at particular risk of street robbery in Kinshasa, Lubumbashi and other urban centres, especially near hotels and supermarkets in the centre of town.

safety.en: In Kinshasa, robberies can be carried out by people posing as taxi drivers or taxi passengers, often with a threat of violence.
safety.es: En Kinsasa, los robos pueden ser cometidos por personas que se hacen pasar por taxistas o pasajeros, a menudo con amenazas de violencia.
safety.quote: In Kinshasa, robberies can be carried out by people posing as taxi drivers or taxi passengers, and are often accompanied by a threat of violence.

safety.en: Public gatherings and demonstrations can occur with little or no notice and can quickly turn violent.
safety.es: Las concentraciones y manifestaciones pueden ocurrir con poco o ningún aviso y volverse violentas rápidamente.
safety.quote: Public gatherings and demonstrations can occur with little or no notice and can quickly turn violent.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is not illegal in DRC but is frowned upon by many, and LGBT+ people are known to be harassed.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo no es ilegal en la RDC, pero muchos la desaprueban y se sabe que hay acoso a personas LGBT+.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is not illegal in DRC but is frowned upon by many.

health.en: Medical care is extremely limited and Western-standard facilities outside Kinshasa are almost non-existent, so medical evacuation could be necessary.
health.es: La atención médica es muy limitada y fuera de Kinsasa casi no hay centros de nivel occidental, por lo que podría ser necesaria una evacuación médica.
health.quote: Outside Kinshasa, Western-standard medical facilities are almost non-existent. Medical evacuation to South Africa (or elsewhere) could be necessary.

health.en: There is no general emergency medical number in DRC; for an ambulance, contact a hospital.
health.es: No hay un número general de emergencias médicas en la RDC; para una ambulancia, hay que contactar con un hospital.
health.quote: There is no general emergency medical number in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). If you have a medical emergency which requires an ambulance, contact a hospital to make this request.

health.en: Health risks in DRC include ebola, malaria, cholera, yellow fever and mpox.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios en la RDC incluyen ébola, malaria, cólera, fiebre amarilla y mpox.
health.quote: See what health risks you’ll face in DRC including:

health.en: Wikivoyage says you should not drink tap water.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que no se debe beber agua del grifo.

health.en: Wikivoyage says you will need a yellow fever vaccination to enter the country by air.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que se necesita la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar al país por vía aérea.
health.quote: You will need a yellow fever vaccination in order to enter the country by air

health.en: Wikivoyage says Congo is malarial, so use insect repellent and sleep under mosquito nets.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que el Congo es zona de malaria, por lo que se recomienda repelente y mosquiteros.
health.quote: Congo is malarial, although slightly less in the Kivu region due to the altitude, so use insect repellent and take the necessary precautions such as sleeping under mosquito nets.

help.en: In Kinshasa you can contact the fire service on 118 and the police on 112.
help.es: En Kinsasa puedes contactar a los bomberos en el 118 y a la policía en el 112.
help.quote: If you are in Kinshasa, you can contact the fire service on 118, and the police on 112.

help.en: Support from the UK government is severely limited outside Kinshasa.
help.es: La ayuda del gobierno británico es muy limitada fuera de Kinsasa.
help.quote: Support from the UK government is severely limited outside Kinshasa.

getting_in.en: The main gateway to the DRC is Kinshasa-N'djili airport (FIH).
getting_in.es: La principal puerta de entrada a la RDC es el aeropuerto de Kinsasa-N'djili (FIH).
getting_in.quote: The main gateway to the DRC is Kinshasa-N'djili airport (FIH IATA).

getting_in.en: The DRC's second city Lubumbashi (FBM) has an international airport.
getting_in.es: Lubumbashi (FBM), la segunda ciudad, tiene un aeropuerto internacional.
getting_in.quote: The DRC's second city Lubumbashi (FBM IATA) has an international airport

getting_in.en: Passenger and VIP ferries run daily between Brazzaville and Kinshasa roughly every two hours from 08:00 to 15:00.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris diarios entre Brazzaville y Kinsasa aproximadamente cada dos horas, de 08:00 a 15:00.
getting_in.quote: Passenger and VIP ferries also locally known as 'Canot Rapide' operate daily between Brazzaville and Kinshasa roughly every two hours 08:00-15:00.

getting_in.en: There are no international passenger trains from neighboring countries.
getting_in.es: No hay trenes internacionales de pasajeros desde países vecinos.
getting_in.quote: There are no international passenger trains from neighboring countries

getting_around.en: Because of the size of the country, the poor roads and the security situation, the only way to get around quickly is by plane.
getting_around.es: Por el tamaño del país, el mal estado de las carreteras y la seguridad, la única forma rápida de desplazarse es en avión.
getting_around.quote: the only way to get around the country quickly is by plane.

getting_around.en: During the rainy season roads become muddy and most long-distance road journeys become virtually impossible.
getting_around.es: En la temporada de lluvias las carreteras se embarran y casi no se pueden hacer viajes largos por carretera.
getting_around.quote: During the rainy season, the roads become muddy, making most long-distance road journeys virtually impossible.

getting_around.en: A ferry on the Congo River operates, if security permits, from Kinshasa to Kisangani every week or two.
getting_around.es: Si la seguridad lo permite, un ferri recorre el río Congo de Kinsasa a Kisangani cada una o dos semanas.
getting_around.quote: A ferry on the Congo River operates, if security permits, from Kinshasa to Kisangani, every week or two.

getting_around.en: Roads are poorly maintained and largely unpaved, and often not drivable with a standard vehicle, especially from September to May.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras están mal mantenidas, en su mayoría sin asfaltar, y a menudo no son transitables con un vehículo normal, sobre todo de septiembre a mayo.
getting_around.quote: Roads in the DRC are poorly maintained, largely unpaved and often not drivable with a standard vehicle, especially during the rainy season from September to May.

getting_around.en: A 1968 International Driving Permit is needed to drive in DRC.
getting_around.es: Se necesita un Permiso Internacional de Conducir de 1968 para conducir en la RDC.
getting_around.quote: You’ll need a 1968 International Driving Permit (IDP) to drive in DRC.

getting_around.en: Security forces operate roadblocks, particularly after dark, and documents should be shown through closed windows from inside the vehicle.
getting_around.es: Las fuerzas de seguridad ponen controles, sobre todo de noche, y los documentos deben mostrarse desde dentro del vehículo con las ventanillas cerradas.
getting_around.quote: If you are asked to produce documents for inspection at a checkpoint, stay inside your vehicle and show them through closed windows.

money.en: The local currency is the Congolese franc (CDF).
money.es: La moneda local es el franco congoleño (CDF).
money.quote: The local currency is the Congolese franc, sometimes abbreviated FC and sometimes just with a capital F placed after the amount (ISO international currency code: CDF).

money.en: Credit cards are only accepted in a limited number of places in Kinshasa and other cities, and elsewhere cash is needed.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito se aceptan en pocos lugares de Kinsasa y otras ciudades; en el resto hace falta efectivo.
money.quote: Credit cards are only accepted in a limited number of places in Kinshasa and other cities.

money.en: US dollars are widely used alongside the local currency, and notes should be in good condition and issued after 2001.
money.es: Los dólares se usan ampliamente junto a la moneda local, y los billetes deben estar en buen estado y ser posteriores a 2001.
money.quote: US dollars are widely used alongside the local currency and a number of ATMs dispense US dollars in Kinshasa. Notes should be in good condition and issued after 2001.

money.en: You can withdraw money with a Mastercard or Visa card at all Ecobank or Equity banks ATMs in DRC.
money.es: Se puede retirar dinero con Mastercard o Visa en todos los cajeros de Ecobank o Equity en la RDC.
money.quote: You can withdraw money with a Mastercard or Visa card at all Ecobank or Equity banks ATMs in DRC.

etiquette.en: Show respect to elders and authority figures, and do not use first names unless told to.
etiquette.es: Hay que mostrar respeto a los mayores y a las autoridades, y no usar nombres de pila salvo que lo indiquen.
etiquette.quote: it is customary to show respect to elders and authority figures.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph people without their explicit permission, especially women or children.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes a personas sin su permiso explícito, sobre todo a mujeres o niños.
etiquette.quote: Do not photograph people without their explicit permission; most certainly, do not take pictures of women or children without their consent.

etiquette.en: Taking photographs of some government and military buildings is illegal, particularly borders or military installations.
etiquette.es: Es ilegal fotografiar algunos edificios gubernamentales y militares, en especial fronteras o instalaciones militares.
etiquette.quote: Taking photographs of some government and military buildings is illegal, particularly borders or military installations.

etiquette.en: Wearing military-style clothing could get you misidentified as military personnel.
etiquette.es: Llevar ropa de estilo militar podría hacer que te confundan con personal militar.
etiquette.quote: If you wear any military-style clothing you could be misidentified as military personnel and be vulnerable to attack or detention.

etiquette.en: The national flag is raised and lowered at dawn and dusk, and all traffic and pedestrians must stop.
etiquette.es: La bandera nacional se iza y arría al amanecer y al anochecer, y todo el tráfico y los peatones deben detenerse.
etiquette.quote: All traffic and pedestrians must stop for this ceremony.

connectivity.en: SIM cards and prepaid recharge are available in the street and at Kinshasa-N'djili airport.
connectivity.es: Hay tarjetas SIM y recargas prepago en la calle y en el aeropuerto de Kinsasa-N'djili.
connectivity.quote: SIM cards and prepaid recharge for mobile phones are available in the street and at Kinshasa-N'djili airport, at a reasonable price.
